title: YWHAZ variation causes intellectual disability and global developmental delay with brain malformation.

reviewer.method: Full main text all332lines read including methods, references and captions. All six numbered figures plus graphical abstract viewed. Both main tables viewed. audit.exposure_note: This actual reviewer saw aggregate benchmark results in the inherited conversation and HANDOFF.md before this reading assignment. No per-case ranking outputs were opened for these source reviews. Retrieval work exposed bibliographic identities and selected-case counts, not per-case inference ranks. This review is not blinded.

segregation.statement: Variant follows affected maternal pedigree and is absent in tested unaffected relatives; TableS2 excludes nine alternative candidates.

evidence.locator: Results Identification of YWHAZ variation; Figure1A; Discussion

phase.statement: Single heterozygous candidate; no compound-heterozygous phase question. Pedigree supports maternal transmission for descendants; origin in I-2 is not established.
limitations: Single-allele phase is not an independently measured haplotype.

causal_confidence.statement: Segregation plus knockin/knockdown fly memory and brain phenotypes support candidate causality; nine alternatives assessed, with ARHGAP4/AGPS/APOL3/KREMEN1 retained as possible modifiers. Paper discusses gain-of-function Ser230Trp separately. Packet Popov-Chang syndrome naming is a later nosologic mapping, not the paper conclusion.
limitations: Single family; docking is prediction; no proof that all features, especially febrile seizures, arise from this allele.
No clinical therapeutic efficacy demonstrated.

phenotype_completeness.statement: Core clinical profile matches III-3. Packet omits detailed motor/speech delays and short stature in children, EEG details, and some behavioral features. Adult ages are ranges. Several feature-specific negatives are inferred from lists.
limitations: Published phenotyping differs by age and incomplete examinations; NA is not absence.

limitations: Transcript and assembly conversion not independently validated.
